fit.onlyDigest: Only enough for the automatic digest (about {{total}} tokens a day); automatic summaries will rarely run
fit.onlyDigestCluster: Only enough for the automatic digest and overviews (about {{total}} tokens a day); automatic summaries will rarely run
fit.overLimit: After about {{digest}} tokens for the automatic digest, the remaining budget still covers more than {{limit}} articles a day, so the budget isn’t the bottleneck
fit.overLimitCluster: After about {{digest}} tokens for the automatic digest and {{cluster}} tokens for automatic overviews, the remaining budget still covers more than {{limit}} articles a day, so the budget isn’t the bottleneck
fit.fits: After about {{digest}} tokens for the automatic digest, enough for about {{n}} articles a day
fit.fitsCluster: After about {{digest}} tokens for the automatic digest and {{cluster}} tokens for automatic overviews, enough for about {{n}} articles a day

unlimited.plain: Automatic summaries use at most about {{most}} tokens a day ({{limit}} articles × about {{per}}, plus about {{digest}} for the automatic digest; estimated)
unlimited.cluster: Automatic summaries use at most about {{most}} tokens a day ({{limit}} articles × about {{per}}, plus about {{digest}} for the automatic digest and {{cluster}} for automatic overviews; estimated)

upgrade.title: Automatic summaries are off
upgrade.body: Background summaries call the generation model for every new article and are the main ongoing cost, so this update turns them off. “Summarize this article” in the reader and daily digests still work.
upgrade.reenable: To turn it back on: Settings → Models → Automatic tasks. With your current setting ({{tier}}), about {{tokens}} tokens per article (estimated).
upgrade.budgetDefaulted: Automatic tasks now have daily budgets: {{generation}} tokens a day for generation and {{embedding}} tokens a day for embeddings. When one runs out, that kind of task pauses for the day and resumes the next day. You hadn’t set a budget before (unlimited), so this default now applies; you can change it under “Usage”.
upgrade.budgetKept: Your daily budget of {{budget}} tokens is kept as the daily generation budget. Embeddings are counted separately, with a default of {{embedding}} tokens a day.

budgetNote.fit: About {{tokens}} tokens per article with the {{tier}} input setting. {{fit}} (estimated).
budgetNote.unlimitedOn: Currently unlimited: {{text}}. Consider setting a cap, for example 200k tokens.
budgetNote.unlimitedOff: Currently unlimited. Consider setting a cap, for example 200k tokens.

generation.label: Generation usage
generation.hint: Read-only. Automatic and manual summaries, digests, and memory consolidation all count; days follow your local time.
generation.paused: Today’s generation budget is used up, so automatic summaries and digests are paused until tomorrow. Manual summaries and digests still work.

embedding.label: Embedding usage
embedding.paused: Today’s embedding budget is used up, so new articles can only be found by full-text search until tomorrow. Summaries and digests aren’t affected.

chat.label: Chat usage
chat.hint: Read-only. Chats don’t count toward any budget.

auto.label: Automatic summaries
auto.disabled: Automatic summaries are off. “Summarize this article” and digests still work.
auto.enabled: Automatic summaries are on. The next batch starts within {{minutes}} minutes.
auto.enabledWithBudget: Automatic summaries are on, with a daily generation budget of {{budget}} tokens. The next batch starts within {{minutes}} minutes.

on.intro: Writes summaries for new articles in the background, shown directly on the cards in Today. This is an ongoing cost.
on.scopeWindow: Only articles added in the last {{days}} days with a positive score are processed; for older ones, select “Summarize this article”.
on.scopeLimit: At most {{limit}} articles a day (manual summaries don’t count), in batches of {{size}} every {{minutes}} minutes.
on.scopeCostBudget: About {{tokens}} tokens per article with the {{tier}} input setting; daily generation budget {{budget}} tokens. {{fit}} (estimated).
on.scopeCostUnlimited: About {{tokens}} tokens per article with the {{tier}} input setting; the daily generation budget is unlimited.
on.noModel: No model is selected for “Summary”, so automatic summaries are paused
on.pausedToday: Summarized today: {{today}} · generation budget used up; resumes tomorrow

off.intro: When off, nothing is summarized in the background. “Summarize this article” still works while reading, and the daily digest is still generated; articles without a summary are picked by title alone, so the digest may be a little thinner.
off.enableFit: Once on, only positively scored articles added in the last {{days}} days are processed, at most {{limit}} a day. {{fit}} (estimated).
off.enableUnlimited: Once on, only positively scored articles added in the last {{days}} days are processed, at most {{limit}} a day; the daily generation budget is currently unlimited.
off.noModel: No model is selected for “Summary” yet: you can turn this on now, and it starts once you pick one.

neutral.label: Extra summaries for neutral unread articles

cluster.label: Automatic overviews for related coverage
cluster.disabled: Automatic overviews are off. “Summarize” still generates one on demand.
cluster.enabled: Automatic overviews for related coverage are on. The next batch runs after automatic summaries.

on.intro: Writes overviews for related coverage in Today in the background, ready when you expand a group, the same as the ones you generate with “Summarize”. Counts toward the daily generation budget.
on.scopeSources: Only groups with at least 2 sources whose newest article is within 3 days are covered; groups without an overview go first.
on.scopeUpdate: Groups that already have an overview are updated only after a new article arrives and more than 24 hours have passed since the last generation.
on.scopeLimit: At most {{limit}} groups a day, after automatic summaries; about {{per}} tokens per group, at most about {{most}} tokens a day (estimated).
on.noModel: No model is selected for “Related coverage overview”, so automatic overviews are paused
on.pausedToday: Overviews today: {{today}} · generation budget used up; resumes tomorrow

off.intro: When off, overviews are generated only when you select “Summarize”. When on, RRSS writes overviews for multi-source related coverage in the background, at most {{limit}} groups a day and about {{tokens}} tokens a day (estimated), counting toward the daily generation budget.

dialog.title: Turn on automatic summaries?
dialog.intro: When on, RRSS calls the generation model in the background to write summaries for new articles. This is an ongoing cost: usage accumulates every day the app is open.
dialog.scopeWindow: Only positively scored articles added in the last {{days}} days are processed.
dialog.scopeLimit: At most {{limit}} articles a day, in batches of {{size}} every {{minutes}} minutes; manual summaries don’t count.
dialog.estimateFit: About {{per}} tokens per article, enough for about {{n}} articles a day
dialog.estimateOnlyDigest: About {{per}} tokens per article; the budget only covers the automatic digest
dialog.estimateOnlyDigestCluster: About {{per}} tokens per article; the budget only covers the automatic digest and overviews
dialog.deduct: Rough estimate with the current input setting ({{tier}}); the daily generation budget is {{budget}} tokens, minus about {{digest}} tokens a day for the automatic digest.
dialog.deductCluster: Rough estimate with the current input setting ({{tier}}); the daily generation budget is {{budget}} tokens, minus about {{digest}} tokens a day for the automatic digest and {{cluster}} for automatic overviews.
dialog.estimateNote: Actual usage varies with article length and model. When the budget runs out, everything stops until the next day, including the automatic digest, which uses the same budget.
dialog.unlimitedIntro: The budget is currently unlimited. Once on: {{text}}. Consider setting a cap first:
dialog.budgetInvalid: Enter a number greater than 0; you can change it later under “Usage”.

vector.title: Vector space
vector.intro: Vectors can only be compared with vectors from the same model, so your library is bound to one embedding model.
vector.effortRemote: about {{tokens}} tokens, billed at your provider’s rates

bind.title: Bind vectors for your library
bind.effortUnknown: the time depends on the number of articles
bind.message: Vectors for your library will be generated by {{label}}: about {{chunks}} chunks, {{effort}}. Changing the embedding model later requires rebuilding the entire vector space. Generation runs in the background; you can keep using the app meanwhile.

change.title: Change embedding model and rebuild
change.message: Switching from {{from}} to {{label}} requires regenerating about {{chunks}} chunks, {{effort}}. Until the rebuild finishes, related articles and chat search keep using {{from}}; they switch automatically when it’s done, and the old vectors are replaced.

dims.label: Vector dimensions
dims.hint: Only some models support reduced dimensions (such as OpenAI text-embedding-3, Gemini embedding, Qwen3-Embedding, and EmbeddingGemma); other models perform noticeably worse at fewer dimensions. The default stays at or below 1024 dimensions to save space.
dims.hintStale: Vector generation is paused. Restore the original configuration before changing dimensions.
dims.hintBuilding: The vector space is rebuilding. You can change dimensions after it finishes or is canceled.

resize.title: Adjust vector dimensions
resize.truncate: Adjusts the vector space from {{from}} to {{to}} dimensions by truncating the existing {{chunks}} chunks locally; no requests are made and no cost is incurred. Search keeps using the current {{from}} dimensions until it finishes.
resize.rebuild: Adjusts the vector space from {{from}} to {{to}} dimensions, which requires regenerating vectors: about {{chunks}} chunks, {{effort}}. Search keeps using the current {{from}} dimensions until the rebuild finishes.

vector.unbound: No embedding model yet. Without one, chat search uses full-text search only, and ranking doesn’t use vectors.

building.resizing: Adjusting the vector space to {{dims}} dimensions: {{written}} / {{total}} chunks
building.rebuilding: Rebuilding the vector space with {{model}}: {{written}} / {{total}} chunks
building.keepDims: Until the rebuild finishes, search keeps using the current {{dims}} dimensions; it switches automatically when done.
building.keepModel: Until the rebuild finishes, search keeps using {{model}}; it switches automatically when done.

cancel.title: Cancel rebuild
cancel.messageDims: The new vectors generated so far will be deleted, and the dimensions go back to {{dims}}.
cancel.messageModel: The new vectors generated so far will be deleted, and embeddings go back to the previous model.

stale.title: New vector generation is paused
stale.defaultReason: The service returns vectors that differ from the ones the space was built with; the model version or quantization may have changed.
stale.existingUsable: Existing vectors still work for search.
stale.probeMismatch: The vectors don’t match the ones the space was built with; the connection, model version, quantization, or dimensions may have changed.

check.title: Check generation setup
check.hint: Periodically checks whether the service’s vectors have changed; if they have, generation pauses and you’re notified.

notice.readFailedRetry: Couldn’t load translation settings. Try again:
notice.readFailedKept: Couldn’t load translation settings; your input was kept:
notice.testFailed: Settings saved, but the test failed:
notice.saveFailedNoTest: Couldn’t save; the test wasn’t started:

reading.title: Reading
reading.enableHint: When off, translations don’t appear in the reader.
reading.langCodeHint: For other languages, enter a code such as de (German) or fr (French).

service.title: Service
service.hint: Picking one applies it right away. Each service keeps its own URL and key when you switch.
service.testDirtyTitle: Saves your changes first, then tests

deepl.hint: Enter your DeepL API key. Free-plan keys end in :fx. If you leave the custom URL empty, the official endpoint is chosen from the key.

deeplx.hint: Enter the URL of your DeepLX deployment; if the service requires authentication, fill in the Token as well.

model.hint: The same as the “Translation” task on the Models page.
